about.title: About

meta.title: About Mohamed Amine Gharrab
meta.description: Full-Stack Developer specializing in web applications, AI-powered automation, e-commerce and digital transformation.

items.desc: In-house developer for a group of retail brands. I built an AI studio that turns product photos into model shots, a B2B lead platform, and an export website connected to its own CRM. I also rebuilt a three-language PrestaShop store (20+ custom modules, from page 10 to page 1 on Google), moved another store from WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9, and trained the whole group to work with Claude.
My own Shopify store for home comfort products, delivering across Morocco with cash on delivery. I built the store and the brand, from the logo to the positioning.
An inventory, order and sales platform with dashboards and stock alerts, built with React, Node.js and PostgreSQL.
A multilingual business website, designed mobile-first, with analytics and social media connected.

expertise.title: Useful AI, not gimmicks
expertise.desc: I add AI where it saves real time: writing, sorting, qualifying leads, producing visuals. Everywhere else, I keep things simple and reliable.

innovation.title: Results you can measure

impact.title: Your team stays in control
impact.desc: I train the people who will use the tool and write the guides. The tool suggests, and your team always has the final say.

meta.title: Mohamed Amine Gharrab Projects
meta.description: Full-Stack Developer specializing in web applications, AI-powered automation, e-commerce and digital transformation.

projects.subtitle: Recent work: AI tools, CRMs and online stores, most of them built for a group of retail and export brands.

1.title: Visualforce AI Documentation Generator
1.description: An open-source command-line tool for Salesforce teams. It reads Visualforce pages and their Apex classes, then writes clear Markdown documentation with an AI summary of what each page does. Documenting legacy pages becomes a one-command job.
features: Reads Visualforce pages: forms, fields, buttons and page blocks
Finds the controllers, extensions and Apex methods behind each page
AI summary of what each component is for
Structured Markdown output: overview, components, controllers
Editable Handlebars templates
Runs from the command line, source code on GitHub

2.title: Bakery SaaS
2.description: A management platform for bakeries: stock, orders and sales in one place, with live figures so less goes to waste at the end of the day.
features: Live stock levels and delivery reception
Recipes linked to their ingredients
Point of sale and online orders
Sales dashboard and customer records

captions.0: Login page for BakeryOS SaaS with secure authentication
captions.1: Stock Reception Overview showing incoming inventory and alerts
captions.2: Recipe Overview with ingredient management and preparation steps
captions.3: Product Overview dashboard with sales and product metrics
captions.4: POS Overview for seamless checkout and order management
captions.5: Inventory Overview with detailed stock levels and analytics

6.title: Lead Intelligence Platform (SLI)
6.description: Built for an export team that was looking for distributors by hand. The platform finds target companies and their decision-makers, scores each prospect with AI and follows it through to the sale. Nobody gets contacted until a person has said yes.
features: Company discovery from web search and AI suggestions, reviewed by a person
Contacts enriched with the decision-makers first
AI scoring: buying intent, signals and a suggested first message
Kanban pipeline, follow-ups, calendar and exportable reports
Separate views for export and local markets, with roles
Checks for duplicates, anomalies and badly formatted data

7.title: Group-wide Claude AI Training
7.description: I designed and ran the generative AI training for the whole group. Each department was interviewed first, so every session and every custom Claude Skill matches a real part of their job.
features: Interviews with each department before any session
Group-wide introduction sessions
Hands-on workshops for each department
Custom Claude Skills for each team's recurring tasks

8.title: E-commerce Redesign, SEO & Custom PrestaShop Modules
8.description: A scarf and shawl brand with its own stores had an online shop few people found, with no link to the stock in its stores. I rebuilt it in French, English and Arabic, wrote more than 20 custom modules, connected it to the store stock and reworked the SEO. It went from page 10 to page 1 of Google in all three languages, and I still look after it every day.
features: Redesign in French, English and Arabic: theme, pages and customer journey
20+ custom modules: upsells, cart rewards, tiered discounts, affiliate tracking, live sales notifications, sales by channel
Stock synced from the ERP twice a day, with in-store availability on every product page
Multilingual SEO: page 10 to page 1 of Google in all three languages
Daily maintenance, updates and security monitoring

9.title: M.A.G Store
9.description: My own Shopify store, selling home comfort products across Morocco with cash on delivery. I set up the store and created the brand, from the logo to the positioning.
features: Shopify store set up and run day to day
Delivery across Morocco, cash on delivery
Brand identity: logo and positioning

10.title: VR Showroom
10.description: A personal project for real estate developers: buyers visit each property online, in 3D or in 360°. Every visit is recorded and scored in a built-in CRM, so the sales team knows who to call first.
features: Project catalogue with renderings and unit types
Interactive floor plan that follows the chosen surface
3D model: rotate it, open each room, read its dimensions
Walkthrough and 360° panoramas
Built-in CRM: lead scoring, assignment and pipeline
Analytics: visit paths, lead funnel, most viewed properties

11.title: Simtis Studio - AI Fashion Visuals
11.description: Before this tool, showing a new shawl on a model meant a photo shoot. Now a store uploads a product photo and gets model shots for the website, social media and customer catalogues in a few clicks. Built in-house at SIMTIS.
features: Model shots from one product photo: pose, setting, way of wearing, photo style
Two AI engines: lifestyle scenes and posters, or a faithful virtual try-on
Shared queue with daily and monthly quotas for each store
Approval step: each image is approved or sent back
Product sheets in three languages, exported as PDF
Short video clips made from a finished image

12.title: Export Showcase Site & B2B Prospecting CRM
12.description: A heritage scarf and shawl house wanted to sell to wholesalers abroad. I built a multilingual showcase site for trade buyers, and behind it a CRM that finds, scores and follows international prospects until their first order.
features: A catalogue you leaf through like a book, with no cart: every page leads to a trade enquiry
Multilingual, with a right-to-left Arabic version, designed for mobile
Enquiries saved and resent until they reach the CRM, with bots filtered out
Prospect search on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, scored in several languages
Human review, duplicate detection, a 7-stage pipeline and follow-ups
Roles, territories and a history no one can edit

13.title: WooCommerce → PrestaShop 9 Migration
13.description: A fashion store moving from WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9 had three things it could not lose: its customers, its order history and its Google rankings. All three made the move, along with the catalogue, the content and a new custom theme.
features: Python extractor for the public site (read-only) and the WooCommerce data
Replayable import with a dry run: no duplicates, manual edits never overwritten
Customers and full order history migrated, totals checked against the source
Custom theme and modules: editable homepage blocks, blog, one-page checkout
A 301 redirect for every old URL, generated and checked automatically
Automated browser tests on desktop and mobile, plus deployment guides

14.title: WordPress Store Redesign
14.description: Redesign of a WordPress website showcasing nonwoven materials and custom bags for business customers. Visitors can browse the catalogue, choose product colours and request a quote, on desktop or mobile.
features: Catalogue of nonwoven materials and custom bags
Product colour options and a quote request form
Website available in French, English and Spanish
Responsive navigation on desktop and mobile

15.title: AI LinkedIn Post Generator
15.description: A workspace for turning ideas into LinkedIn drafts with AI. Choose a short post, a longer article-style post or a carousel, keep your best drafts in one place, and organise upcoming content in a calendar.
features: AI-assisted drafts based on a topic you provide
Short, long and carousel formats
Post history with favourites and copying
Content calendar with ideas, dates, categories and completion tracking

16.title: Invoice OCR & Data Extraction
16.description: Configurable invoice data extraction for JPG and PDF documents. Users can select the fields they need or request broader extraction, then review, edit and validate the results directly in the application before receiving structured JSON or CSV output.
features: JPG and PDF invoice processing
User-selected fields or broader extraction
In-app review, editing and validation
Structured JSON and CSV outputs

17.title: Medical Practice Management
17.description: A C# application for managing a medical practice and digitising client and insurance records. It combines OCR-assisted capture from handwritten books, Excel imports and accounting exports with role-based permissions, telephone appointment scheduling by the assistant, and invoices that deduct insurance and supplementary coverage and can be emailed to clients.
features: Client and insurance records, with OCR-assisted digitisation
Excel imports and accounting exports
Staff roles with permissions for each role
Dedicated booking screen: availability checks and appointments arranged by phone
Invoices with insurance and supplementary coverage deductions
Invoices sent directly to clients by email

18.title: Banking Agency Application - Final-Year Project
18.description: A Java/JEE application foundation developed for my 2020 final-year project at Eurafric Maroc. Designed for reuse across banking agencies, it supported authentication, onboarding clients participating in public offerings of shares (OPV) and PDF generation. My contribution focused on authentication and the application foundation.
features: Authentication
Reusable application foundation for banking agencies
Client onboarding for public offerings of shares (OPV)
PDF document generation
Permissions and purchase restrictions for OPV workflows
Share purchase price set by the company
Limits on the number of shares each client can acquire
